items.originalTitle: Why Max Verstappen ended F1 practice early in Brazil – Red Bull explains
items.summaryEn: Verstappen finished third in both of Friday's practice sessions in Sao Paulo, and Red Bull ended his running early because of too many inconsistencies in the long-run data.
detailZh: 红牛解释维斯塔潘为何在巴西提前结束F1练习
车队在长距离数据中看到太多不一致之处，这意味着红牛比赛策略主管汉娜·施密茨认为，继续留在赛道上能学到的东西已经不多
维斯塔潘在圣保罗周五的F1练习赛中位列第三。事实上，这位荷兰车手在两节练习赛中都占据这个位置，且每节都落后最快车手约零点二五秒，兰多·诺里斯在第一节最快，基米·安东内利在第二节最快。
红牛总结称，赛车再次具备"足够潜力"在前方竞争，不过在英特拉格斯，维斯塔潘并非一切顺利。在当天第一节练习赛中，他照例抱怨了降挡问题，而动力转向的故障让他在该节末段经历了一番"真正的锻炼"。
在第二节练习赛中，维斯塔潘贡献了本赛季F1迄今为止最有趣的队内无线电对话之一，当时他没有立即理解汤姆·哈特（本周末他再次代替詹皮耶罗·兰比亚塞担任比赛工程师）关于动力单元和变速箱的信息。
“所以我们在开关上没有任何信息，但他们正在适应你，”哈特在队内无线电中说道。这促使维斯塔潘用近乎唱歌的语调回应：“那是什么意思？我得自己跟引擎说话吗？我觉得我应该像‘哦，离合器，我正在切换！否则你会受到惩罚！’”
更值得注意的是，维斯塔潘提前结束了第二节练习赛。在时钟还剩六分多钟时，这位四届世界冠军已经驶入维修区，从队内无线电交流来看，这显然是他自己的建议。
维斯塔潘建议进站，哈特回答说：“好的，马克斯。如果你想进站，那就在这一圈结束时进来。无线电信号变差了，供参考。”
在圣保罗练习日结束时，红牛车队比赛策略主管汉娜·施密茨解释了维斯塔潘为何提前返回维修区：“所以这只是因为我们在长距离跑动中发现了许多不一致之处，我们觉得它不再有帮助了。”
“我们没有获得所需的数据。我们知道我们想要关注和在一夜之间改变的事情，所以我们直接进入了那个阶段。”
这一点尤其值得注意，因为提前进入也意味着维斯塔潘放弃了在发车格上进行练习起步的机会。鉴于何塞·卡洛斯·帕塞赛道（Autodromo José Carlos Pace）的发车格相当陡峭地向上倾斜，而红牛今年的起步并不总是特别好，这一点非常引人注目。
维斯塔潘下车后，可以看到机械师在他的小红牛22下方工作。
至于竞争格局，施米茨总结道，在维斯塔潘赢下最近四场大奖赛中的三场之后，本周末应该再次拥有充足的潜力。
“我认为每个人都同意赛车内部有很大的潜力，但两位车手都有一些他们想要研究并在夜间做出改变的地方。不过从某种意义上说这是好事，因为这意味着我们知道赛车上正在发生什么，以及我们可以解决什么。
“本周末剩余时间里有很大的潜力和乐观情绪。”
然而，天气预报也需要纳入考虑。按照施米茨的测试计划，红牛试图全面了解三种轮胎配方，尽管鉴于气温变化和可能下雨，这些数据的价值仍存疑问。
“我认为今天在哪些节练习用硬胎、哪些节练习用中性胎，是一个非常接近的抉择，”施米茨说道。
“我认为所有顶级车队都测试了全部三种配方，因为它们太相似了。这在很大程度上取决于车手偏好、车队倾向和偏好，而这些正是我们试图弄清楚的事情。
“今天显然条件与周日预报的相当不同，所以现在我们必须研究我们认为这将如何转化为周日发生的情况。我认为这就是困难之处。”
detailEn: Why Max Verstappen ended F1 practice early in Brazil – Red Bull explains
The team saw too many inconsistencies in the long-run data, meaning Red Bull's head of race strategy Hannah Schmitz felt there was little more to learn by staying out longer

Max Verstappen finished Friday's Formula 1 practice sessions in Sao Paulo in third place. The Dutchman occupied that position in both sessions, in fact, and was also around two and a half tenths off the fastest driver in each session, with Lando Norris topping the first one and Kimi Antonelli the second.

Red Bull concludes that there is once again "enough potential" in the car to fight at the front, although not everything went smoothly for Verstappen at Interlagos. During the first practice session of the day, he complained – as usual – about the downshifts, while a problem with the power steering gave him a "proper workout" towards the end of the session.

In second practice, Verstappen provided one of the most entertaining team radio exchanges of the F1 season so far when he did not immediately understand a message from Tom Hart – who is once again replacing Gianpiero Lambiase as his race engineer this weekend – about the power unit and gearbox.

"So we have nothing on the switch, but they are adapting to you", Hart said over the team radio. It prompted Verstappen to respond in an almost sing-song voice: "What does that mean? I have to speak to the engine myself? I think I should be like 'oh, clutch, I’m switching! You’ll be punished otherwise!'"

More noteworthy was the fact that Verstappen ended the second practice session early. With just over six minutes remaining on the clock, the four-time world champion was already heading into the pitlane, apparently at his own suggestion, judging by the team radio exchanges.
Verstappen suggested coming in, to which Hart replied: "Okay, Max. If you want to box, then come in at the end of this lap. Radio has gone poor, for info."

At the end of the practice day in Sao Paulo, Red Bull's head of race strategy Hannah Schmitz explained why Verstappen had returned to the pits early: "So it was just [because of] finding a lot of inconsistencies in the long run and we didn't feel like it was helpful anymore.
"We weren't getting the data we needed. We knew the things that we wanted to be looking at and changing overnight, so we just went straight into that."

That is particularly noteworthy, as coming in early also meant Verstappen gave up the opportunity to carry out a practice start on the grid. Given that the grid at the Autodromo José Carlos Pace slopes quite steeply uphill and Red Bull's starts have not always been particularly good this year, that is remarkable.
After Verstappen got out of the car, mechanics were seen working underneath his RB22.
As for the competitive picture, Schmitz concludes that there should once again be plenty of potential for this weekend, after Verstappen won three of the last four Grands Prix.

"I think everyone agrees that there's a lot of potential within the car, but with both drivers there are things that they want to look into and change overnight. But in a way that's a good thing because that means we know what's happening on the car and what we can address.
"There's a lot of potential and optimism for the rest of the weekend."

However, the weather forecast also needs to be taken into account. With Schmitz's run plan, Red Bull tried to get a good understanding of all three tyre compounds, although the question remains how valuable that data will be given the changing temperatures and the possibility of rain.
"I think it was a very close call on which sessions you ran the hard and which session you ran the medium today", Schmitz said.

"I think all of the top teams kind of tested all three compounds because they are so similar. It comes down a lot to driver preference, team tendency and preference, and those are the kind of things we're trying to get to the bottom of.

"Today, obviously the conditions are quite different to what's forecast for Sunday, so now we have to look at how we think that's going to translate to what happens on Sunday. And I think that's the difficult thing."

items.originalTitle: Leclerc plans 'significant' car changes as Hamilton rues 'difficult' Brazil practice
items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc said he will make "significant" setup changes to his Ferrari after experiencing "one of the worst feelings" in practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, while Lewis Hamilton described the Brazil practice as "difficult."
detailZh: 圣保罗大奖赛：勒克莱尔计划对法拉利赛车做出“大幅”调整，汉密尔顿则称巴西的练习赛“艰难”。
法拉利周五在巴西的速度落后于梅赛德斯、迈凯伦和红牛，勒克莱尔与汉密尔顿都对赛车平衡不满意；周六第三节练习将于下午2点30分进行，排位赛于下午6点在天空体育F1直播。
圣保罗大奖赛周五各节练习的集锦。
勒克莱尔表示，在圣保罗大奖赛的练习赛中经历了“最糟糕的感觉之一”后，他将对赛车做出“大幅”设定调整。
勒克莱尔在第二次练习赛中落后最快车手安东内利零点七秒，汉密尔顿则落后近半秒，法拉利在周五的速度不及梅赛德斯、迈凯伦和红牛。
这与他们近期的表现形成反差，法拉利在最近四场比赛中都登上了领奖台，但勒克莱尔希望他们能在周六下午2点30分的第三次练习赛和下午6点的排位赛中扭转局面，天空体育F1频道将直播。

勒克莱尔表示：“第二节练习非常棘手。实际上，如果要说的话，这是我今年在车里感觉最糟糕的一次，所以有很多工作要做，而且感觉不太对劲。”
“我有一些想法。我们会大幅调整赛车，看看效果如何。我希望我们能向前迈进一步，因为即使我错过了第一节练习，我也不认为那里有多少性能可挖。”
“只是纯粹的速度不够好。”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔表示，在上周墨西哥城大奖赛与法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿发生冲突后，他已“解决”了两人之间的不和。
汉密尔顿全天都在努力让轮胎达到工作温度，这可能成为整个周末的大问题，因为周六下午排位赛预报有雨，而周日将非常寒冷，气温仅15摄氏度。
“这是充满挑战的一天。赛道非常颠簸且湿滑，这让轮胎很难进入正确的工作窗口，”汉密尔顿说。
“第一节练习整体还可以，但第二节练习更加困难。我们收集了大量有用数据，今晚将与车队一起梳理这些数据，弄清在排位赛前赛车可以在哪些方面改进。”
法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔在墨西哥事件后回答关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题
勒克莱尔：成为父亲是最特别的事情
勒克莱尔的妻子亚历山德拉周三诞下女儿比安卡后，他晚些时候才抵达巴西。
这位29岁的车手成为当前发车区第五位当父亲的一级方程式车手，前四位是马克斯·维斯塔潘、费尔南多·阿隆索、尼科·霍肯伯格和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯。
“这绝对是最特别的事情，”他说。
“你多少会期待这一刻，因为我一直想当个年轻爸爸，而且显然和亚历克斯在一起时，我们觉得时机对了，这是一个非常、非常特别的时刻。这一周绝对会因为我永远记住，全是积极的理由。
“当然，这期间也发生了其他事情。但对我来说，这一周全是关于比安卡的，真是太不可思议了。”

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Charles Leclerc plans 'significant' Ferrari car changes as Lewis Hamilton rues 'difficult' Brazil practice

Ferrari were off the pace compared to Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday in Brazil with both Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton unhappy about the car's balance; watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc says he will make "significant" setup changes to his car after "one of the worst feelings" in practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Leclerc was seven tenths off pace-setter Kimi Antonelli in second practice and Lewis Hamilton was nearly half a second behind as Ferrari trailed Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday.

It was a contrast to their recent pace with Ferrari claiming a podium position in the last four races but Leclerc is hoping they can turn that around in final practice on Saturday at 2.30pm and qualifying at 6pm, live on Sky Sports F1.

"FP2 was very tricky. Actually, if anything, one of the worst feeling I've had this year in the car, so there's plenty to work on, and it didn't feel quite right," said Leclerc.

"I've got some ideas. We'll change the car quite significantly, and we'll see how it goes. I hope we can do a step forward because even though I missed FP1, I don't think there was much performance in that.
"It's just the raw pace wasn't great."

Hamilton struggled to generate tyre temperature throughout the day, something which could be a big issue throughout the weekend as rain is forecast for Saturday afternoon during qualifying, and Sunday will be very cold at just 15C.
"It was a challenging day. The track is very bumpy and slippery, which made it difficult to get the tyres into the right window," said Hamilton.

"FP1 was okay overall, but FP2 proved more difficult. We've gathered plenty of useful data, so we'll work through that with the team tonight to understand where we can improve the car ahead of qualifying."

Leclerc: Most special thing ever to become a father
Leclerc arrived late to Brazil after his wife Alexandra gave birth to a baby girl named Bianca on Wednesday.
The 29-year-old becomes the fifth Formula 1 driver on the current grid to be a father after Max Verstappen, Fernando Alonso, Nico Hulkenberg and Sergio Perez.
"It's definitely the most special thing ever," he said.

"You kind of expect it because I've always wanted to be a young dad, and obviously with Alex we felt like it was the right time, and it's a very, very special moment. Definitely a week I'll forever remember for all the positive reasons.
"Of course, there's been other things going on as well. But for me, this week was all about Bianca, and it's been it's been incredible."

detailZh: 弗雷德·瓦瑟尔拒绝成为查尔斯·勒克莱尔孩子的教父：'我有四个孩子'
法拉利车队负责人弗雷德·瓦瑟尔开玩笑说将成为查尔斯·勒克莱尔新生女儿的教父
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔，法拉利
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
法拉利一级方程式车队负责人弗雷德·瓦瑟尔自己排除了成为勒克莱尔女儿教父的可能性，开玩笑说他已经有很多孩子要照顾了。
勒克莱尔和他的妻子亚历山德拉于周三宣布了他们第一个孩子比安卡的出生。
在回答关于上周周末在墨西哥的碰撞后，他的车手之间可能存在的紧张关系的系列问题时，瓦瑟尔在周五的新闻发布会上被问及摩纳哥车手是否请求他成为婴儿的教父。
“我家里有四个孩子，我不想成为我所有车手孩子的教父。”他回答说。
法拉利车队主管在本周处理了很多事情，因为勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿在墨西哥大奖赛的首个回合发生了碰撞。勒克莱尔试图在发车时超越从杆位起步的七冠王汉密尔顿，但两位车手都跑出了赛道。
勒克莱尔取得了领先，但随后因为这次事件被处以五秒罚时。与此同时，汉密尔顿跌至第三，落后于红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘。
瓦瑟尔在新闻发布会上承认，拥有两位竞争激烈的驾驶员会带来问题，但他表示这是他乐于接受的选择。
“我们有两位经验丰富的车手，两位竞争激烈的车手。现在我们已经连续四到五场比赛处于领先位置，在蒙扎和马德里之后获得了最多的积分。”他说。
“然后，当然，你们都想要赢得比赛，所以会有一种升级的趋势。我认为这可能是系统的缺点，因为每个周末我们都有两位竞争激烈的选手并肩作战。”
“但我想如果我们今天排在第二，也是因为我们有两个非常接近的选手，我们必须处理好这一点。但这是一个选择。这是阵容中的选择，我有正面和负面，但我会处理负面。”
“法拉利目前在车手积分榜上以504分排在第二位，落后积分榜领跑者梅赛德斯126分。”
detailEn: Fred Vasseur turns down being godfather to Charles Leclerc’s baby: “I have four children”
Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur joked about becoming godfather to Charles Leclerc's newborn daughter
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Frederic Vasseur, Ferrari
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Ferrari Formula 1 team principal Fred Vasseur has ruled himself out of becoming godfather to Charles Leclerc's daughter, joking that he already has enough children to look after.
Leclerc and his wife, Alexandra, announced the birth of their first child, Bianca, on Wednesday.

After a series of questions about the potential tension between his drivers following last weekend's clash in Mexico, Vasseur was asked in Friday's press conference whether the Monegasque driver had asked him to be the baby's godfather.
"I have four children at home and I don't want to be the godfather of all the children of my drivers," he replied.

The Ferrari team chief has had plenty to deal with this week after Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton's clash on the opening lap of the Mexican Grand Prix. Leclerc attempted to overtake the seven-time champion, who started on pole position, at the race start, but both drivers ran wide.
Leclerc took the lead but was subsequently handed a five-second penalty for the incident. Meanwhile, Hamilton dropped to third behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen.
Vasseur admitted earlier in the press conference that having two competitive drivers comes with problems, but said it was a choice he was happy with.
"We have two experienced guys, two competitive guys. There are now four or five races in a row that we are at the front, scoring the highest number of points after Monza and Madrid," he said.

"Then, for sure, you have a kind of escalation because you all want to win races. I think it's probably the downside of the system, that we have two competitive guys starting each weekend next to each other.

"But I think if we are P2 today, it's also because we have two guys who are very, very close, and we have to manage it. But it's a choice. It's a choice in the line-up, and I have the positive and the negative, but I will deal with the negative.
Ferrari currently sits second in the constructors' standings with 504 points, 126 behind championship leader Mercedes.

Formula 1 heads into Saturday at Interlagos with Kimi Antonelli fastest after second practice for the Brazil Grand Prix.

The newly crowned world champion set a 1m10.763s to lead Lando Norris by 0.253s, with Max Verstappen just 0.006s further back in third. George Russell was fourth ahead of Oscar Piastri, leaving Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull closely matched heading into qualifying.
Russell will also carry a five-place grid penalty into Sunday’s race after Mercedes fitted a sixth internal combustion engine to his car.
With increasingly unsettled weather expected on Saturday, qualifying could provide another complication at a circuit already famous for rapidly changing conditions.
